i.norm:
Verifies a corner case of {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder#isEncodeEquals(String, String)}: a real surname compared against a blank (single-space) string must never be reported as a phonetic match.

The encoder treats a lone space as trivial input and short-circuits to {@code false} before any phonetic comparison takes place, so "Murphy" and " " are expected to be unequal.
